name: StateMachine
src_typeComment: Plain C# state machine, not a MonoBehaviour — call Tick() yourself from an owning MonoBehaviour's Update(). Kept framework-free on purpose: no reflection, no attribute-based transitions, so it's easy to trace and edit.

src_members.sig: public IState CurrentState { get; private set; }
src_members.name: CurrentState

src_members.sig: public bool IsInState<T>() where T : IState => CurrentState is T
src_members.name: IsInState
src_members.comment: Sugar for AddTransition conditions and outside checks alike, e.g. AddTransition(chase, attack, () => stateMachine.IsInState<ChaseState>() && inRange).

src_members.sig: public void AddTransition(IState from, IState to, Func<bool> condition)
src_members.name: AddTransition
src_members.comment: Optional helper: register "if condition true, switch to this state" checked every Tick before the state runs. Skip this entirely and call SetState() manually from your own game logic if you'd rather not use rule-based transitions.
